name: loading-screen
title: Loading Screen
description: A waiting screen: concentration lines turning behind a paper plate, an onomatopoeia in the SFX face in the centre, an optional message and either a determinate bar filled with speed lines (progress 0 to 100) or an indeterminate turning spinner (progress omitted). role=status with aria-live=polite; the SFX is decorative. Fills its container by default; fullscreen covers the viewport (fixed, z-50). Lines stop under prefers-reduced-motion, the states stay distinct.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/loading-screen". Give the container a height (the default fills it; min height 16rem). Use fullscreen only for real page-level waits.

meta.tagline: A waiting screen of concentration lines and a sound effect.
meta.usage:
import { LoadingScreen } from "@/components/manga/loading-screen"

<LoadingScreen message="Loading chapter 12" progress={40} />

<LoadingScreen fullscreen message="Hold on" />

props.name: label
props.description: Screen-reader text announced as the status.

props.name: progress
props.description: 0 to 100 for a determinate bar. Omitted = indeterminate spinner.

props.name: fullscreen
props.description: Fixed, covers the viewport above the page. Otherwise fills its container.
